description: Your recent jobs, newest first, each with its status, progress and for (the media or timeline it is for), filtered by status, tool or media_id. Results are left out unless you ask (result summary or full); job.get reads one.

media_id.description: Only jobs for this media (importing, making or reading it)

result.description: none (default): each job without its result, to find one; summary: lists cut short; full: every result whole

tool.description: Only jobs of this tool, e.g. media.import

name: job.list

for.description: What it is for, known from the start

items.description: Media handle from media.import or a create.* tool

media_id.description: The media it imports, makes or reads

items.description: Media handle from media.import or a create.* tool

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

job_id.description: Job handle; the same value is the MCP task id

result.description: The tool's structured result once completed

result_summary.description: result "summary": the result in brief; result "full" has all of it

cut.description: Path of each cut (a.b.0.c): its full length

value.description: Lists cut to 5 items, long text cut

seconds_left.description: Running: seconds left at its recent rate of progress, once it has moved steadily (later steps may differ)

starts_in_seconds.description: Queued next in line: seconds until a slot should free, when every job holding one has seconds_left

status_message.description: What it is doing; while it waits, its place in the queue and what it waits for (a job slot, a render slot or the sandbox)

title: List jobs
